card.name: Linking word after concomitant use
card.fires_on: The small word (of, with, using) right after 'concomitant use/administration' or 'concomitantly', just before a list of interacting drugs. Mostly in contraindication and interaction sections.

modes.label: of after concomitant noun
modes.description: 'of' follows 'concomitant use' or 'concomitant administration' before a named drug or drug class.

modes.label: with or using after concomitantly
modes.description: 'with' or 'using' follows 'concomitantly' or 'coadministration of X' and leads into the other drug.
